title: fix(plugin-auth)!: clearing an authentication setting, or resetting the namespace, takes effect at once (#30312)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgA9Z648v7EcnvTMWpmnkjL3)_

domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cbvcmv8YWFhFJwzjKL

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup → 认证里清空一个设置（或"恢复默认"整组重置）后，运行值当场回到部署自己声明的值（插件选项 / `auth:configure`，没声明就回内置默认），不再要重启。覆盖全部 33 个认证设置：锁定阈值、每人最大会话、密码策略、会话时长、强制 MFA、API 密钥期限、限流、Google、受众策略等；IP 白名单（#30203）并入同一机制。
- 为什么改：清空后界面显示默认值，但运行时一直沿用上次存的值，直到重启（实测：锁定阈值 3、最大会话 2 清空后仍生效）。管理员以为已经恢复默认，其实没有。
- 风险与回滚：收窄一处（Clause-② `yes (narrowing)`）：部署声明"邮箱密码登录关"、在 Setup 里打开、再关掉了 Google，此时清空"邮箱密码登录"会被拒存（400 `SETTINGS_VALIDATION`），因为清空现在真的会把它关掉、导致无人能登录。其余清空只是开始生效。环境变量锁定的设置不受影响。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-settings-declared.ts`（回落表，每个键走哪一片）；`auth-plugin.ts` 的 `applySettings` 新增回落段与受众回落；`sign-in-method-floor.ts` 清空按声明值判的一行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/auth-settings-clear.pin.test.ts`，预期 17/17 通过，其中第一组断言锁定阈值清空后当场回到声明的 7。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #30312

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — one save an administrator could make before is now refused at the auth settings save door with the existing `SETTINGS_VALIDATION` / `invalid_value` field error at `email_password_enabled`: clearing that toggle on a deployment that itself declared email and password off, when nothing else signs anyone in after the save. Before, that clear was saved and changed nothing at runtime; now a clear applies, and that one would lock everyone out. No error code, settings key or export is added or removed.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches the auth settings namespace, its clear or the sign-in floor.

## Why

`PUT /api/settings/auth` with a key set to `null` (the console's clear), or the namespace reset, answers saved, and the key resolves `source: 'default'`. Every `if (isExplicit(key))` branch in `applySettings` skipped such a key, so the running value kept the last stored one until a restart. Re-measured first on `dbf53efe`, real `AuthPlugin` + `SettingsService`: `lockout_threshold` 3 and `max_concurrent_sessions_per_user` 2 stayed 3 / 2 after `setMany(…, null)`; a reset left `lockout_threshold` 4. Only `allowed_ip_ranges` had a reset arm (#30203, PR #30309).

## What changes

- **One mechanism, not thirty `else` arms.** `auth-settings-declared.ts` holds two pieces of data. `captureDeclaredAuthOptions` takes, once in `init()` after `auth:configure` and before the manager is built, the deployment's own value of every option an `auth.*` key drives. `AUTH_SETTING_RESTORE` names, for each of the 33 keys of the shipped auth manifest, the piece its declared value goes back through.
- **The restore arm in `applySettings`.** The pass keeps the set of keys the running config last took from the store. A key in that set that now resolves `source: 'default'` is restored in the same pass, through the same piece a save of it rides, so the manager judges a restore as it judges a save:
  - plain options (membership policy, password complexity / classes / history / expiry, MFA grace, the four API-key keys, session idle / absolute / concurrent, lockout pair, `allowed_ip_ranges`) ride the plain patch;
  - `emailAndPassword` fields (`email_password_enabled`, `signup_enabled`, `require_email_verification`, `password_min_length`, `password_max_length`) are each their own refusable piece; the verification flag restores as the deployment's declaration (#20389), as at boot;
  - `password_reject_breached` is its own `plugins` piece;
  - `mfa_required` restores as a save of the declared value would apply: a declared on is one piece with `plugins.twoFactor`, a declared off clears the requirement and leaves the enrollment path standing, exactly as an explicit off does;
  - `session_expiry_days` / `session_refresh_days` merge over the declared `session` block (a stored field overrides its declared twin; before, a stored field replaced the whole block);
  - the rate-limit pair and the Google trio restore whole once none of their keys is stored; the audience restores whole once `audience_posture` is not stored, through the same merged-result validation (a sibling still stored without a posture is IGNORED, as before).
  - A key whose restore the manager refuses stays owed and is retried on the next pass. A key the store never gave a value is never touched (boot restores nothing). Env overrides resolve `source: 'env'` and are unaffected.
- **`allowed_ip_ranges`** moves onto the same table; `declaredAllowedIpRanges` / `allowedIpRangesFromSettings` are gone. Its #30203 pins pass unchanged (an undeclared list restores to `undefined`, which the gate reads as open, as `[]` was).
- **The sign-in floor (`sign-in-method-floor.ts`, file surface widened by the seat).** The floor read a cleared `email_password_enabled` as on (the manifest default). With clears now applying, a deployment that declared email and password off could clear the toggle into a lockout. Measured before the floor change: declared off + Google, Setup sets email/password on, then Google off, then clears the toggle → 200, and the running config ends `emailPassword.enabled: false` with no provider. The floor now takes an optional `declaredEmailPasswordEnabled()` reader (from `bindAuthSettings`) and judges a cleared toggle at the declaration; the same clear is refused 400 and nothing changes. With another way in standing, the clear saves and applies.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-settings-clear.pin.test.ts`, 17 cases, on #30203's composition (real `AuthPlugin`, real `SettingsService` with the shipped auth manifest, real settings routes for the save-door cases):

1. The restore table names exactly the shipped manifest's keys.
2. Plain options: the measured case (declared `lockoutThreshold: 7` back to 7; undeclared max sessions back to `undefined`); password classes + API-key max expiry; a pass about one stored key applies only that key's option (`applyConfigPatch` spy).
3. Refusable pieces: `emailAndPassword` fields; breached-password flag; `mfa_required` to a declared off (enrollment stays) and to a declared on (with `twoFactor`); the floor refuses the clear with no other way in (code, field, `invalid_value`, runtime unchanged) and lets it through with Google standing.
4. Groups: session merge; rate-limit pair; Google; audience (all three cleared; posture alone cleared with siblings stored).
5. Namespace reset across families; an env-pinned `OS_AUTH_LOCKOUT_THRESHOLD` survives a reset.

Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty; tests import `src/`, no dist in the path):

| Ablated | Red |
| --- | --- |
| A1 plain-patch arm | 7 (incl. all three #30203 clear pins) |
| A2 `emailAndPassword` arm | 3 |
| A3 `plugins` arm | 1 |
| A4 session arm | 1 |
| A5 `mfa_required` declared-off arm | 1 |
| A6 `mfa_required` declared-on arm | 1 |
| A7 rate-limit group | 2 |
| A8 Google group | 1 |
| A9 audience restore | 2 |
| A10 floor reads a clear at the declaration | 1 |
| A11 store tracking (restore every unstored key) | 1 (the spy pin) |

## Acceptance notes

- With one rate-limit key cleared and the other stored, the explicit branch keeps building the limit with its built-in fallbacks (10 / 60) for the cleared half, not the declared `rateLimit`; unchanged from before.
- A deployment that declared `mfaRequired: true` while `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=false` restores to its own contradictory boot state on a clear; the gate's once-per-process warning (#30201) names it. Not filed: boot already lands there.

## Verification

Readings under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, shared box. **Landing head `c22645eb`**: `8b9f159f` plus a merge of `origin/main` at `f506b79d` (29 commits, among them PR #30449 for #30300). One hand resolution, in `auth-plugin.ts`: #30449's one-line `registerSignInMethodFloor(…, this.signInMethodFloorDeps(…), …)` taken, and this PR's `declaredEmailPasswordEnabled` reader moved into that shared constructor (read only by the save floor's batch fallback; the SSO-provider delete floor and the boot report judge the running config). Delta contract review PASS, comment 6659465418.

On `c22645eb`, one run under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, every step exit 0): closure build of `dogfood^...` and `service-settings^...`; full dogfood Test Files 419 passed, 3 skipped (422), Tests 3492 passed, 36 skipped (3528); `@objectstack/plugin-auth` test 225/225 files, 3991 passed, 10 skipped (4001); plugin-auth typecheck exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck` OK); `@objectstack/service-settings` test 68/68 files, 1156/1156; service-settings typecheck exit 0.

Earlier readings, kept for the record: code head `f58be8f5`; `8b9f159f` was that plus a merge of `origin/main` (23 commits, none touching `auth-plugin.ts`, `sign-in-method-floor.ts` or `service-settings`).
